name: GOV safe: ChangedMasterCopy (singleton change)
description: Safe singleton (implementation) change: ChangedMasterCopy(address), emitted by Safe 1.1.1 and 1.2.0 changeMasterCopy and by the Safe migration helpers, by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity critical. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the new singleton and says whether it is a canonical Safe implementation; anything else is critical (the singleton-swap takeover route). Also see the posture audit: it catches a silent slot 0 change that emits no event.
